subject.title: Dashboard: widget write-back — a setState bridge capability + persisted widget state

question: Should OpenClaw accept a bundled dashboard widget write-back capability now, and what storage/security contract should it use for persisted widget state?
rationale: The request is useful and roadmap-aligned, but it changes iframe-to-parent write authority, plugin/dashboard API shape, and persisted state ownership that automation should not decide.

options.title: Sponsor With Storage And Security Design
options.body: Proceed after the dashboard base lands, but require a reviewed bridge contract, approval semantics, SQLite or approved plugin-state storage, and adversarial regression tests.

options.title: Defer Under The Roadmap
options.body: Keep this open under the Wave 2 roadmap until the foundation PRs settle and maintainers can evaluate the added security surface in context.

options.title: Reject Bundled Write-Back For Now
options.body: Close or narrow the direction if maintainers decide stateful custom widgets should remain outside bundled OpenClaw until demand is proven elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Sponsor With Storage And Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed after the dashboard base lands, but require a reviewed bridge contract, approval semantics, SQLite or approved plugin-state storage, and adversarial regression tests.
